drums.description: Indie rock with a driving, rhythmic focus, The track features a clean electric guitar playing a syncopated, percussive riff using palm-muted eighth notes, A prominent bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with a slightly overdriven tone, The drum kit maintains a steady groove with a tight, dry snare and consistent hi-hat eighth notes, A second electric guitar enters with melodic, single-note lines using light chorus and delay effects, The arrangement is centered around a repetitive, interlocking rhythmic motif between the guitar and bass, Key of A minor, Tempo is 120 BPM, 4/4 time signature Publish

bass.description: Lo-fi hip hop instrumental, The track features a dusty, sampled drum break with a prominent, muffled kick and a crisp, slightly off-grid snare, A repetitive four-bar electric bassline plays syncopated eighth notes with a warm, rounded tone, The melodic centerpiece is a melancholic, jazz-influenced electric piano progression using seventh chords, processed with a subtle vibrato and bit-crushed texture, Atmospheric vinyl crackle and hiss are layered throughout the arrangement, A muted, filtered trumpet enters periodically, playing short, melodic fragments with heavy reverb, The tempo is 88 BPM in the key of C minor Publish
